title: Withdrawal Allowances Across the Paystride Save Tiers
content:
Withdrawals move money out of a Paystride Save account. Each tier allows the following.

| Tier | Withdrawals per calendar month | Fee per withdrawal | Most withdrawn in one calendar day | Withdrawals to the Paystride card are instant | Withdrawals to an outside bank account | Business days for an outside-bank withdrawal to arrive | A withdrawal may take the balance below zero |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | 6 | $0.00 | $500.00 | Yes | Not allowed | 2 | No |
| Paystride Save Builder | 6 | $0.00 | $1000.00 | Yes | Not allowed | 2 | No |
| Paystride Save Boost | 6 | $0.00 | $2000.00 | Yes | Not allowed | 2 | No |
| Paystride Save Growth | 10 | $0.00 | $3000.00 | Yes | Allowed | 2 | No |
| Paystride Save Premier | 10 | $0.00 | $5000.00 | Yes | Allowed | 2 | No |
| Paystride Save Elite | 10 | $0.00 | $5000.00 | Yes | Allowed | 2 | No |

The schedule in plain terms:

- Paystride Save Starter, Builder and Boost allow 6 withdrawals in a calendar month; Growth, Premier and Elite allow 10.
- No tier charges for a withdrawal: the fee is $0.00 on every tier.
- The most that can be withdrawn in one calendar day rises with the tier, from $500.00 on Starter to $5000.00 on Premier and Elite.
- Withdrawals to the Paystride card are instant on every tier.
- Withdrawals to an outside bank account are allowed only on Paystride Save Growth, Premier and Elite. The schedule lists 2 business days for such a withdrawal to arrive on every tier; on Starter, Builder and Boost that figure has no withdrawal to apply to, because outside-bank withdrawals are not allowed there.
- On no tier may a withdrawal take the balance below zero.
